purpose: Finite research questions for autonomous population of empirical Solar resource state for CIVPROP.

authority.coverage_destination: separate epistemic coverage/frontier ledger; UNKNOWN must not be fabricated as material evidence

excluded_body_classes.BARYCENTER: mathematical/dynamical reference point, not a material body
excluded_body_classes.SPACECRAFT: artifact, not a natural resource body

required_questions.question: What empirical evidence exists for volatile-bearing material on or in this body, with what abundance, form, spatial scope and uncertainty?
What empirical evidence exists for metallic or economically relevant metal-bearing material on or in this body, with what abundance, form, spatial scope and uncertainty?
What empirical evidence exists for silicate/rock-forming material on or in this body, with what abundance, mineralogy, spatial scope and uncertainty?
What empirical evidence exists for carbonaceous or organic material on or in this body, with what abundance, form, spatial scope and uncertainty?

execution_order: reuse already-qualified Solar Facts material evidence
acquire scalable authoritative structured sources once and resolve identities deterministically
extract body/material assertions with provenance and scope
perform targeted body-specific research only for decision-relevant unresolved lanes
assign explicit coverage/frontier disposition for every required body-family lane
freeze candidate database, coverage matrix, artifact manifest and unresolved frontier
hard_rules: A required question is family-level; priority materials guide discovery but do not close the material vocabulary.
Do not create a material_evidence row merely to encode UNKNOWN.
No row and UNKNOWN are distinct states; UNKNOWN belongs in coverage/frontier accounting.
Taxonomy may be retained as taxonomy or a downstream prior but may not be converted to target-specific abundance.
Regional/site evidence may not be globalized.
A model or analog inference may not be relabelled as direct measurement.
Conflicting evidence must coexist; autonomous research may not silently select a winner.
Do not infer resource grade, recoverability, extraction efficiency, economic value, settlement value, delta-v or flight time.
Do not redesign Solar Facts DDL during this campaign.
Do not modify Navigator, CIVPROP, technology assumptions or economic models.
stop_rule: Stop when every eligible body x required resource-family lane has an explicit coverage disposition and all scalable authoritative sources selected for this campaign have been exhausted. UNKNOWN_AFTER_SEARCH is a valid terminal result. Do not initiate further source discovery solely to reduce UNKNOWN count.
success_metric: 100 percent coverage accounting, not 100 percent resource knowledge.
